items.prompt: Root 10 has left child 5, whose right child is 12. Why is this proper tree INVALID as a strict BST?

options.text: 12 exceeds its parent 5, so every right edge is invalid.
options.why: A right child should exceed its parent; that local comparison is legal.

options.text: 12 violates the inherited ancestor upper bound 10.
options.why: Parent-only comparisons miss constraints from earlier ancestors.

options.text: Every tree with a left-right grandchild is invalid.
options.why: The shape is legal; the specific ordering violation matters.

options.text: The root must always be the smallest tree value.
options.why: A BST may have smaller values in its left subtree.

items.explanation: Parent-only comparisons miss constraints from earlier ancestors.
